name: Feltre (Italy)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a crowned white castle (the arms of Feltre), with the motto NEC SPE NEC METV on a white scroll beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Feltre, a comune in Veneto; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: scroll with motto NEC SPE NEC METV
